Hiring team guide

How apply1234 works.

apply1234 turns your notes on a role into a job posting with a hidden link. Candidates who find the link answer your questions on video. You then review, score and interview them in one place. This guide shows every screen, menu and setting, with pictures.

Hiring leadSet up and post a jobNotes, AI draft, the hidden link, the activity page and job boards. ReviewerReview candidatesWatch answers, score them, read the signals, shortlist and interview. CandidateSee what applicants seeEvery screen of the application, from the posting to the thank-you page.

Everyone on the hiring team has the same access, so every part of this guide applies to every team member. Pictures use sample data. Updated November 8, 2026.

01 · The big picture

From notes to a hire

Three stages. You set the job up, candidates apply through the hidden link, and you decide. The app measures how each candidate moves through the middle stage.

03 · Hiring lead

Post a job in five steps

On the Jobs page, click + New job. A step-by-step wizard takes you from rough notes to a job you can post. Your progress saves as you go, so you can switch to your AI tool and come back.

1

Paste your notes

Duties, must-haves, schedule, pay and what success looks like. Rough bullet points are fine. Leave the title blank and the AI suggests one.

Pick how many video questions (3 to 6) and how long each answer should be.

Keep the hidden code word switched on. The posting asks candidates to put this word in every video title, and the app checks for it, which shows who read the posting closely.

2

Choose the hidden link

A random code like apply1234.com/7nu6-sw79 keeps the job private: nobody can guess it, and the site never lists jobs. You can also use a word and number, or type your own.

The link is checked as you type. A green ✓ means no other job uses it or anything close to it.

Choose how many pieces to split it into and how each piece appears in the posting.

3

Copy the AI prompt

The prompt holds your notes and tells the AI exactly how to format its reply. Click Copy prompt, paste it into Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, then copy the AI's whole reply.

Prefer writing it yourself? Use Skip, I'll write it myself to start from a standard posting.
4

Paste the reply

Paste the AI's reply. The app sorts it into a title, the posting, screening questions, interview questions and a rubric, and shows what it found with green ticks.

The link pieces and the code word sentence are placed into the posting automatically if the AI left them out.

5

Review and launch

Check the summary and the posting preview. Placeholders like [add pay range] are flagged so you can fill them in.

Create as draft saves it privately. Create and go live opens the activity page to candidates. Then copy the posting to your job boards.

Hiring for a similar role again? On step 1, open Duplicate a job instead to copy a past job's posting, activity page and questions with a fresh private link.

04 · Hiring lead

Inside a job

Open any job from the Jobs page. Changes save automatically a moment after you stop typing.

Overview

Status switches the job between Draft (only you can open it), Live (candidates can apply) and Closed (the page tells visitors applications are closed).

Activity link opens the candidate page. Signed in as an admin, your visit counts as a test.

Copy for job boards copies the posting formatted for each site. Pick a board under Posting for and the copy uses that board's own link.

On the right, a funnel shows how many people viewed, found the page, started and submitted, and a table breaks results down by job board.

Notes & posting

Your original notes stay on the left for reference.

The posting editor uses Markdown. Lines like {{part1}} mark where each link piece appears. They are filled in automatically wherever the posting is shown or copied.

1. Copy AI prompt / 2. Paste the AI's reply redraft the posting from your notes at any time. Save a snapshot under Versions before a big rewrite, so you can go back.

Hidden link

Change the link, re-split it into 2 to 6 pieces, and fine-tune each piece. A green line confirms the pieces add up to the full link. Hint format sets how each piece is labelled in the posting.

Links per job board gives LinkedIn, Indeed and others their own version of the link, ending in a short code. You'll see which board sends the best candidates, and if one link leaks you can switch only that one off. You can also switch the main link off so only board links work.

Changing the link of a live job breaks it for anyone who already pieced it together.
Activity page

Everything candidates see once they find the link: the headline and introduction, the Loom setup steps, the shortest and longest suggested answer, extra instructions and an optional deadline.

Switches control transcripts (candidates paste Loom's transcript under each answer, so AI exports can read what they said), the code word, the consent line and an accommodations email.

Save a setup as a template to reuse it on the next job.

Questions

The video questions, each with an optional tip for the candidate. Move them up or down, edit or remove them, paste a list, or use the AI prompt to draft more.

Good questions ask for a specific past situation, a realistic scenario from the role, a "teach us something" moment and how they approached this application.
Interview

Interview questions mix general ones that suit any role with custom ones written for this job. They appear on each candidate's page during the interview.

Confirmation email goes out automatically when someone submits. Edit its wording or switch it off here.

Emails holds the interview invite and rejection templates. Scheduling link (Calendly, Cal.com and similar) is added to invites. The Rubric lists the criteria reviewers score.

Candidates

This job's applicants by stage, with their flags and scores. It works like the main Candidates page, filtered to one job.

05 · Reviewer

Review candidates

Every applicant moves through the same stages. Change a stage from the candidate's page or the list.

The candidate page

Further down the page

  • Résumé and cover letter appear when the candidate added them. Files open in a new tab, and the link expires after 10 minutes.
  • Notes are shared with the whole hiring team.
  • Tags are free labels like "strong writer", searchable on the Candidates page.
  • Interview sets the date and holds the interview questions, each with space for notes and a score, plus a summary box.

Export for AI review

The Export button builds one document with the role, questions, rubric and the candidate's answers, signals, scores and notes, with instructions for an AI reviewer at the top. Paste it into Claude or another model to get a second opinion. Switch on Hide names and emails for a blind review.

To compare everyone who applied to a job, use Export candidates on the job's Overview tab.

What the flags mean

FlagMeaning
✓ LoomEvery answer is a working Loom link. × Loom means at least one link points somewhere else.
✓ LengthEvery video is within the suggested length. × Length means at least one is outside it. Length is a guide and never blocks a submission. Loom doesn't share the length of some videos, so this flag can be missing.
✓ CodeThe hidden code word is in the video titles, so they read the posting closely. × Code means it's missing.
2 wrong triesWrong addresses they typed before finding the page.
via LinkedInThey used the LinkedIn version of the link.
RésuméThey attached a résumé or cover letter file.
RepeatSomeone already applied to this job with the same email.
TestA team member submitted it while testing. Tests are left out of every dashboard number.

The Candidates page

06 · Reviewer

Reading the behavior signals

The Behavior panel on each candidate's page shows how they worked. Read the signals as context next to their answers. On their own they don't decide anything.

SignalWhat it measuresWhat it can suggest
Wrong link triesWrong or partial addresses typed on apply1234.com before finding the page. Links they tried lists them.Persistence and how they solve a puzzle. Many tries that get closer each time show method.
Arrival → submitTime from first opening the activity page to submitting.Whether they did it in one sitting or came back later.
Answering timeTime from starting the questions to submitting.How long the recording itself took.
On setup stepsTime spent on the Loom setup instructions.Comfort with a new tool. Learning Loom quickly is part of the activity.
Active on pageTime the page was open and visible.Effort, when compared with the total time.
Switched awayHow often they left the tab, and for how long.Usually recording in Loom. Long breaks are normal.
Failed link checksPasted links that weren't valid Loom links.Attention to detail with instructions.
Came from / ReferrerWhich job board link they used, and the site they came from.Which boards bring your best applicants.
Time zone / DeviceFrom their browser.Where they are and whether they applied on a phone or a computer.
Tracking is tied to one browser. Someone who switches devices starts fresh, so their numbers only cover the device they submitted from.

07 · Everyone

The Overview dashboard

The top of the Jobs page. It answers "what happened lately, and what needs me?" Your own test visits are never counted.

08 · Everyone

Inbox and help messages

Every activity page has a Help button in the corner. Candidates choose Something isn't working, Question about the role or Something else, write a message and leave their email.

  • New messages show an orange dot and raise the count on the Inbox menu item. Team members with alerts on also get an email.
  • Open a message to see the step they were on, their browser and screen size, any error they saw and whether they've applied. Yes, open their application jumps to their page.
  • Reply by email opens your email app with their message quoted.
  • Mark done moves it to the Done list. Add a private note for the team at any point.

In email templates, {first}, {name}, {role} and {link} are replaced with the candidate's first name, full name, the job title and your scheduling link. Test runs by a team member are marked [Test] in the subject.

10 · Everyone

Activity log

A running record of everything that happens on candidate pages: arrivals, steps, link checks, submissions and every wrong address typed on apply1234.com.

  • Switch between Wrong links and Everything, and filter by job.
  • Most-tried wrong links shows the addresses people guess most often. If many people make the same mistake, a piece in the posting may be unclear.
  • Wrong tries are matched to the closest live job, and to the candidate when that same browser later submits.
  • Hide my test visits leaves out what you did while testing.

11 · Everyone

Settings and your team

Email me when

Each team member chooses their own alerts: when someone finishes an activity, and when a candidate sends a help message.

Add a teammate

  1. Type their email under Hiring team and click Add.
  2. Send them to apply1234.com/admin. They click First time? Create your login and use that same email.
  3. They click the link in the confirmation email. They now see every job and candidate.

Templates

Activity page setups saved from a job. Rename or delete them here.

Signing in marks your browser as an admin browser, so your visits to activity pages count as tests.

12 · Hiring lead

Share a job with someone

Hiring for a client or a manager? Give them access to one job, without adding them to your hiring team. They sign in with their own login and see only that job.

AccessThey canThey can't
ReviewerWatch the video answers, fill in their own scorecard, give a recommendation and add notes.See candidates' contact details or move stages unless you allow it, open résumés if you turn that off, edit the job, email candidates, or see any other job.
Full access to this jobEverything you can do on this job: edit the posting, hidden link, activity page and questions; set it live; move candidates; send invite and reject emails; export.See other jobs, the Overview dashboard, Inbox, Activity log or Settings; delete the job or candidates; give anyone else access.
Hiring teamEverything, on every job. Add them under Settings › Hiring team.Nothing is off limits, so keep this for your own team.

Invite someone

  1. Open the job and stay on its Overview tab.
  2. Under People with access to this job, type their email and name, choose Reviewer or Full access to this job, set their Permissions, and click Send invite.
  3. They get an email from hiring@apply1234.com. They create a login at apply1234.com/admin with that same address and confirm their email.

A reviewer's permissions: whether they can see candidates' contact details (off by default), can open résumés and cover letters, see only shortlisted candidates, move candidates between stages, and get new-candidate emails. Résumés usually include a phone number and address, so turn both off to keep contact details fully private. Change any of these later under Options. Remove access takes effect straight away; their scores and notes stay.

Each person keeps their own scorecard, so you can compare everyone's scores under Other reviewers on each candidate.

What a reviewer sees

Reviewers land straight on the job. Each candidate shows their auto-check flags, the team's average score and whether they still need to score them. To score filters down to the ones they haven't done yet.

A candidate's page shows the answers, résumé, notes, the behavior signals and their own scorecard. Contact details are hidden unless you allow them, and there are no buttons to email, move or delete candidates.

13 · Candidate

What candidates see

Most candidates apply on a phone, so these are phone screens. Scroll sideways to follow the whole journey. Click any screen to enlarge it.

Rules candidates work within

  • Progress is saved on their device, so they can leave and come back.
  • Every question needs a video link before they can continue. When transcripts are on, each answer needs its transcript too. A box under the button lists exactly what is still missing.
  • Video length is a guide only and never stops them from submitting.
  • They can submit again to fix something. You'll see the second submission marked Repeat.

What they never see

  • The code word check, the signals and any of the tracking.
  • Other jobs. The site never lists jobs, and a job's page opens only through its own link.
  • This guide. It lives behind the admin sign-in.

14 · Everyone

Tips and fixes

How do I test a job the way a candidate would?

Open the job's activity link while signed in. Everything works, including on Draft jobs, and the page shows a "Preview" bar. Your visits and submissions are marked Test, left out of the dashboard, and their emails say [Test]. To see it exactly as a stranger does, use a private browser window.

A candidate says the link doesn't work

Check that the job is Live and, if they used a job board link, that the board link is switched on under Hidden link. Then open Activity › Wrong links: you'll see exactly what they typed.

A video shows no length

Loom doesn't report the length of some videos, often ones uploaded rather than recorded in Loom. The link still counts as valid and the candidate can submit. Watch the video to judge its length.

Can I change the link after posting?

Yes, but anyone who already pieced together the old link will hit "Nothing here". To retire one job board's link only, use New code or Turn off on that board instead.

How do I stop new applications?

Set the job's status to Closed on its Overview tab, or set a deadline on the Activity page tab. Visitors then see that applications are closed.

Someone applied twice

The newer submission carries a Repeat flag. Review the latest one and reject or delete the older one.

Emails aren't arriving

Check Settings › Email me when, then your spam folder. Candidate confirmations can be switched off per job on the Interview tab, so check that too.

Deleting a candidate

Delete candidate at the bottom of their page removes their answers, scores and notes for good. Moving them to Rejected keeps the record instead.

Use apply1234 like an app on your phone

On iPhone, open apply1234.com/admin in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open it in Chrome and choose Install app. It opens straight to your dashboard.
